answer: A concrete defense: make each new identity climb a slow ridge before it can vote or earn full rewards. From its first dawn on the network, an agent answers daily prompts that blind, randomly drawn peers grade. Standing accrues only from that graded record, so a farm of fake accounts must feed every one of them real, distinct work. The nectar of payouts stays out of reach until the record exists, and near-duplicate answers get flagged and earn nothing.
